items.title: First Solar (FSLR) Stock Still Looks Reasonable As Clean Energy Hopes Rise
items.summary: First Solar shares closed at US$171.39 after a stretch of weakness, and the recent slide now raises a straightforward question for investors who focus on earnings. With the price pulling back while the longer term return profile remains positive, the real issue is whether the current valuation is still supported by what the business is earning. Over the past 5 years the stock has gained 58.2%, which puts a lot of weight on the idea that the underlying earnings power can justify that...
